summary: CWE-378: `File.createTempFile` creates the temporary file with default, overly permissive permissions (world-readable on many systems), exposing its contents. Replaced it with `java.nio.file.Files.createTempFile(...).toFile()`, which on the default provider creates the file with permissions restricted to the owner. The rest of the feature (writing to and deleting the temp file) is unchanged.
